content.text:
Cameras serialized with `toJSON()` now keep their up-vector when loaded back with `ObjectLoader`. I made two one-line changes and haven't run any tests or the example from the issue.

- **`src/core/Object3D.js`**: `toJSON()` now writes the up-vector as `object.up = this.up.toArray()`, next to the existing `matrix` entry.
- **`src/loaders/ObjectLoader.js`**: `parseObject()` now reads it back with `if ( data.up !== undefined ) object.up.fromArray( data.up );`. JSON saved before this change has no `up` field, so it still loads with the default (0, 1, 0).

The fix is in `Object3D`, so every 3D object now saves its up-vector, not only cameras. Every object's JSON output gains a new `up` field. Any existing unit test that compares `toJSON()` output against a fixed expected object will need updating.
